title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: premium rate and minimum premiums by tier
content:
## Scope

This comparison table covers the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line and gives, for every tier, the premium or ad valorem rate and the two minimum premium figures held for a cover.

## Tier table

| Tier | Premium or ad valorem rate (percent of insured value) | Minimum premium per container covered | Minimum premium per cover |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability | 0.00 percent | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| AHL Declared Value Liability | 1.50 percent | 60.00 USD | 75.00 USD |
| AHL CargoCare Essential | 0.12 percent | 25.00 USD | 35.00 USD |
| AHL CargoCare Plus | 0.18 percent | 35.00 USD | 50.00 USD |
| AHL CargoCare Premium | 0.25 percent | 50.00 USD | 75.00 USD |
| AHL CargoCare Total | 0.35 percent | 75.00 USD | 100.00 USD |

## Definitions

- **Premium or ad valorem rate**: the premium, or the ad valorem charge, expressed as a percent of the insured value, stated to 2 decimal places.
- **Minimum premium per container covered**: a minimum premium figure in US dollars for each container the cover takes.
- **Minimum premium per cover**: a minimum premium figure in US dollars for the cover as a whole.

## Basis Q&A

**Which tier has the highest rate?** AHL Declared Value Liability, at 1.50 percent of the insured value; among the CargoCare tiers the rate rises from 0.12 percent (Essential) to 0.35 percent (Total).

**Do the per-container and per-cover minimums differ between AHL Declared Value Liability and AHL CargoCare Premium?** The per-cover minimum is the same (75.00 USD), while the per-container minimum differs (60.00 USD against 50.00 USD).

**What does the AHL Standard Carrier Liability row show?** Every figure on that row is 0.00.
